name: ctpa_acute_pe_rv_strain_full
clinical_history: 58M, sudden onset pleuritic chest pain and dyspnoea, SpO2 91% on air, HR 112, D-dimer 4.2, Wells score 6. Query PE.
findings: Good contrast opacification of the pulmonary arterial tree. Filling defects in the right main pulmonary artery extending into the lower lobe segmental branches, with a further filling defect in a left lower lobe segmental artery. RV:LV ratio 1.2 with flattening of the interventricular septum. Small right pleural effusion. Mosaic attenuation in the right lower lobe without consolidation. No pericardial effusion. No aortic dissection or mediastinal haematoma. Heart size within normal limits. No mediastinal or hilar lymphadenopathy. Central airways patent. Incidental 5 mm right upper lobe pulmonary nodule. Thyroid and imaged upper abdomen unremarkable. No suspicious osseous lesion.

name: mri_lumbar_disc_extrusion_full
clinical_history: 34F, 6 weeks left leg pain radiating to sole of foot, weak plantarflexion, failed conservative management. Query disc prolapse.
findings: Five lumbar-type vertebrae with normal alignment. No spondylolisthesis or pars defect. Vertebral body heights preserved with normal marrow signal. At L5/S1 there is a left paracentral disc extrusion with inferior migration which compresses the traversing left S1 nerve root within the lateral recess; the left lateral recess is moderately narrowed and the central canal is preserved. At L4/5 a mild disc bulge without nerve root compression. Remaining discs are normal. Facet joints unremarkable at all levels. Conus is normal and terminates at T12/L1. Sacroiliac joints and paraspinal soft tissues unremarkable.

name: clean_mri_ankle_fragments_full
findings: Mild to moderate ankle joint effusion. Osteochondral fracture of the posteromedial talar dome with reactive bone marrow oedema in the talus. No fracture of the distal tibia or fibula. The medial ligaments and posterior tendons are unremarkable. The lateral ligament complex is intact. The peroneal tendons are intact. Achilles tendon and plantar fascia normal. Sinus tarsi clear. No tendon tear.

name: ct_head_cerebellar_haemorrhage
clinical_history:
onset at 13:30 with left facial droop, left arm and leg weakness and slurred speech.
BP 255/161
findings:
- There is a large area of parenchymal hemorrhage in the right cerebellum measuring 5 cm in diameter with significant peri-lesional vasogenic edema and this is causing major midline shift across the horizontal cerebellar axis with complete effacement of the cerebral aqueduct and fourth ventricle and crowding of the foramen magnum due to ipsilateral tonsillar herniation

- There is some regional subarachnoid and subdural extension of haemorrhage along the tentorium

- The background brain parenchyma otherwise appears unremarkable with no gross areas of infarction

- Background chronic small vessel ischemic changes and age-appropriate involutional atrophy are noted with asymmetric predominance of the right frontal lobe

name: ct_ap_diverticulitis_abscess
clinical_history: 66F, 4 days left iliac fossa pain, fever 38.2, WCC 15, CRP 180. Query diverticulitis.
findings:
- Sigmoid diverticulosis with segmental wall thickening over 6cm
- Pericolic fat stranding
- 3.2cm rim-enhancing pericolic collection adjacent to sigmoid
- No free intraperitoneal gas
- Trace pelvic free fluid only
- Ureters not obstructed
- Liver, spleen, pancreas, adrenals, kidneys unremarkable
- No suspicious osseous lesion

name: mri_spine_mscc
clinical_history: 72M metastatic prostate cancer, PSA 85. Three weeks progressive thoracic back pain, 48 hours bilateral leg weakness with two falls, new urinary hesitancy. Query cord compression.
findings:
- Multilevel vertebral metastases at C7, T3, T7, T9, L2 and L4
- T7 posterior vertebral body and pedicle involvement with epidural soft tissue component
- Epidural disease at T7 compresses the cord, with high T2 cord signal at this level
- Greater than 50% canal compromise at T7
- T9 epidural disease abuts the cord without compression
- Conus normal, no cauda equina compromise
- T7 vertebral height loss 30% with 15 degrees kyphosis
- L4 pathological fracture, no retropulsion
- Paraspinal soft tissue mass at T7 extending to the costovertebral junctions
